🟦Project Description:


Our partner, a top tier Hedge Fund, is expanding their AI agent platforms. We are looking for a Senior Python Developer with Typescript to build and maintain business applications.


🟦Responsibilities:


• Design, develop, and maintain application components on python backend and typescript frontend

• Follow best practices and coding conventions

• Continuously improve the application performance and development tools

• Leverage internally available AI tools to scale software development


🟦Mandatory Skills Description:


• 3+ years of commercial software development

• Strong python with OOP

• Hands-on TypeScript

• Clear communication


🟦Nice-to-Have Skills:


• Experience or education in Capital Markets, Trading, or Investment

• React/Angular

English: Upper Intermediate
